rule: STANDING RULE 3 — TYPE LAW: every glyph is LIVE TYPE (renders as real DOM text in build, never baked) or TEXTURE TYPE (ambient set paint — may bake). This per-frame index is coarse; the role table governs.

liveAlways: all Courier Prime (slates, TC, verb legend, HUD, tags, paperwork)
all Fragment Mono + Saira Condensed (bench plates, machine logs)
any painted-looking figure carrying data (archive counter, stat headlines, title cards, leader frames)
textureMayBake: chalk hit-marks, tape scribbles, coffee rings (glyphic set dressing)
